metadata.name: swap_amm
metadata.description: Brink singleton rates AMM: pools, swaps, hooks, flash accounting and settlement on Solana

instructions.name: admin_create_pool
docs: Creates a pool for a benchmark, with its share mint, vault and optional hook set.

instructions.name: admin_initialise_global
docs: Creates the global account and the fee vault. Called once by the deployer, then the authority is handed
to the timelock PDA with `admin_set_authority`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The deployer: must be this program's upgrade authority (review finding F-14), so the singleton cannot be
created by whoever lands the first transaction after deployment.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's own `ProgramData` (loader-owned, address derived from the program id).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: Canonical USDC (mainnet or devnet); checked by address in the handler. Decimals must be 6.

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: Unswept fees. Owned by the global PDA.

instructions.name: admin_queue_calibration
docs: Publishes a new Vernier calibration that becomes effective after `Global.param_delay_slots`.

instructions.name: admin_set_authority
docs: Hands authority (and guardian) to new keys.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The incoming authority co-signs, so a mistyped key cannot take governance (review finding F-17).

instructions.name: admin_set_basis_pair
docs: Governance enables a basis pair: pay fixed on `pool_a` against receive fixed on `pool_b`, with the
correlation offset applied to both legs' demand charge. Absent the pair, basis swaps are refused.

instructions.name: admin_set_mode
docs: Sets the operating mode: Normal, Limited, WithdrawOnly, Halted. The guardian may only tighten.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Authority may set any mode; guardian may only tighten, and never past WithdrawOnly (checked in handler).

instructions.name: admin_update_basis_pair
docs: Governance changes an existing pair's correlation offset.

instructions.name: crank_liquidate_swap
docs: Permissionless crank: liquidates a swap whose collateral is exhausted or within six hours of maturity.

accounts.name: global
docs: Read-only: fees accrue on the pool (review F-29, ADR-001).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Trader for `cancel`; anyone for `settle` / `liquidate`.

accounts.name: cranker_usdc
docs: Where the crank bounty goes on `settle` / `liquidate`. Must belong to the signer. Omit it (or crank your own
position) and no bounty is paid.

instructions.name: crank_process_withdrawals
docs: Permissionless crank: closes the open epoch, fills it pro rata up to the capacity the caps leave.

accounts.name: benchmark
docs: Prices the queued shares conservatively against the open book (ADR-008): the same value an immediate
`lp_withdraw` would receive, so the queue never pays more than the exit path.

instructions.name: crank_settle_swap
docs: Permissionless crank: settles a matured swap against the average index and closes it.

accounts.name: global
docs: Read-only: fees accrue on the pool (review F-29, ADR-001).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Trader for `cancel`; anyone for `settle` / `liquidate`.

accounts.name: cranker_usdc
docs: Where the crank bounty goes on `settle` / `liquidate`. Must belong to the signer. Omit it (or crank your own
position) and no bounty is paid.

instructions.name: crank_start_forward
docs: Permissionless: records a forward's start reading once its start has passed.

instructions.name: init_withdraw_queue
docs: Permissionless, once per pool: creates the withdrawal queue and the share escrow.

instructions.name: lp_claim_withdrawal
docs: Permissionless: pays a processed request to the destinations recorded at enqueue and returns its
unfilled shares.

accounts.name: lp_usdc
docs: Any USDC account owned by the LP (the one recorded at enqueue, or a fresh associated token account
that anyone may create for them), so a closed destination can never leave a request unclaimable (H-1).

accounts.name: lp_shares
docs: Any share account owned by the LP, likewise.

instructions.name: lp_deposit
docs: LP deposits USDC and receives pool shares at the current share price.

accounts.name: global
docs: Read-only: deposits book no fee, so the shared account takes no write lock (ADR-001, review F-29).

accounts.name: benchmark
docs: Read-only: prices the open book at the current accrual and published value (ADR-008, maths M-12).

instructions.name: lp_dequeue_withdraw
docs: LP takes escrowed shares back while the request's epoch is still open.

instructions.name: lp_enqueue_withdraw
docs: LP escrows shares and joins the open epoch. Priced at processing, not now.

accounts.name: lp_usdc
docs: Recorded as the claim destination; must belong to the LP and hold USDC.

instructions.name: lp_withdraw
docs: LP burns shares for USDC, paying the exit fee while swaps are open. Serves only inside the withdraw
utilisation limit; beyond it fails with `UseWithdrawQueue`.

accounts.name: global
docs: Read-only: the exit fee accrues on the pool (review F-29, ADR-001).

accounts.name: benchmark
docs: Read-only: prices the open book at the current accrual and published value (ADR-008, maths M-12).

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: Permissionless, per pool: moves the pool's accrued platform fees 50/50 from its vault to the buyback
escrow and the treasury.

accounts.name: global
docs: Written only here (lifetime counters); never on the hot path.

instructions.name: sync_vault
docs: Permissionless: folds USDC sent directly to a pool vault into LP capital.

instructions.name: trader_cancel_basis_swap
docs: Trader closes both legs of a basis swap early, with one floor on the net payout.

accounts.name: trader
docs: The trader signs: both legs are theirs (`has_one`), and the rent of both returns to them.

instructions.name: trader_cancel_swap
docs: Trader cancels early at the then-current opposite-leg quote; the difference settles against collateral.

accounts.name: global
docs: Read-only: fees accrue on the pool (review F-29, ADR-001).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Trader for `cancel`; anyone for `settle` / `liquidate`.

accounts.name: cranker_usdc
docs: Where the crank bounty goes on `settle` / `liquidate`. Must belong to the signer. Omit it (or crank your own
position) and no bounty is paid.

instructions.name: trader_open_basis_swap
docs: Trader opens a basis swap: two linked legs, pay-fixed on pool A and receive-fixed on pool B, same tenor
and notional, each collateralised in its own pool, in one transaction.

accounts.name: pair
docs: The pair record: its presence enables the pair, its offset prices it. Seeds bind it to this ordering.

instructions.name: trader_open_forward_swap
docs: Trader opens a forward-starting swap: a fixed rate agreed now on the Vernier forward curve for a swap
whose floating accrual begins 28, 60 or 90 days ahead.

accounts.name: global
docs: Read-only: fees accrue on the pool (review F-29, ADR-001).

accounts.name: benchmark
docs: Owner check is implicit: `Account<Benchmark>` requires the index program as owner.

instructions.name: trader_open_swap
docs: Trader opens a fixed-for-floating swap. The fixed rate is quoted in this slot and must be within
`limit_rate_bp` or the instruction fails (the AMM equivalent of slippage protection).

accounts.name: global
docs: Read-only: fees accrue on the pool, so the shared account takes no write lock (review F-29, ADR-001).

accounts.name: benchmark
docs: Owner check is implicit: `Account<Benchmark>` requires the index program as owner.

types.name: BasisPair
docs: Governance-set correlation offset for one ordered benchmark pair: a basis swap pays fixed
on `pool_a` and receives fixed on `pool_b`. `correlation_bp` is the fraction of each leg's demand charge that
the pair's documented positive correlation offsets; it never touches the model or tenor components. The
account's absence means basis swaps are not enabled for the pair. Seeds `["basis", pool_a, pool_b]`.

types.name: BasisPairSet
docs: A basis pair created or updated by governance.

types.name: BasisSwapClosed
docs: Both legs of a basis swap closed by the trader in one instruction; each leg also emits `SwapClosed`.

types.name: BasisSwapOpened
docs: One basis swap opened: two linked legs, each also announced by its own `SwapOpened` on its pool.

fields.name: offset_bp
docs: Demand charge removed across both legs by the correlation offset, bp.

types.name: Benchmark
docs: Benchmark account. The swap AMM reads this layout directly (owner-checked), so field order is frozen per
`version`; both programs upgrade together when it changes.

fields.name: prev_value_bp
docs: Value held over the most recent accrual segment `[prev_unix_ts, unix_ts]` (maths finding M-2).

fields.name: prev_unix_ts
docs: Start of the most recent accrual segment; equals `unix_ts` until the second accepted value.

fields.name: max_drift_bp
docs: Drift bound (S-6): the value may move at most this far from `drift_anchor_bp` within one window.

fields.name: clamped
docs: The last accepted value was clamped by the band or the drift bound.

fields.name: disputed
docs: The last aggregation had a quorum of fresh observations that did not agree; the value was not moved.

fields.name: support
docs: Observations that supported the last accepted value. `1` means a single-publisher (devnet) registry.

fields.name: ema_milli_bp
docs: EMA at bp x 1 000 (maths finding M-6). `ema_bp` is `rhu(ema_milli_bp / 1 000)`; at most
`MAX_RATE_BP x 1 000`, so it fits `u32` and the `u16` narrowing of `ema_bp` cannot fail.

fields.name: fixing_first_day
docs: UTC day number (unix seconds / 86 400) of the oldest fixing ever written; 0 until the first midnight the
benchmark lives through.

fields.name: fixing_head_day
docs: UTC day number of the most recent fixing written.

fields.name: fixings
docs: Ring of `FIXING_DAYS` daily fixings: the cumulative accrual (`accrual_e18` units) at 00:00 UTC of day `d`
lives at byte offset `16 * (d % FIXING_DAYS)` as a little-endian `u128`. Written by `publish` for every
midnight a segment crosses; read by the AMM to settle a swap at its maturity whatever was published later
(ADR-006, review finding F-12, maths finding M-2, simulation finding S-3). Raw bytes rather than
`[u128; N]` so that loading the account is a copy, not a per-element decode.

fields.name: ema_slot
docs: Slot at which the EMA last moved (or was confirmed equal to its input); the decay of the next step is
measured from here, not from the last publication (M-11).

fields.name: accepted_slot
docs: Slot of the transaction that last accepted a value. `slot` is the freshness of the data behind it (M-12);
this is when the benchmark itself last moved, used to widen the band after an outage.

types.name: BookSide
docs: One side of the open book: the four signed aggregates for one leg.

types.name: EpochFill
docs: Record of one processed epoch.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Epoch index; `u64::MAX` for a slot never used.

fields.name: shares_queued
docs: Shares queued when the epoch was processed.

fields.name: shares_filled
docs: Shares burned (filled) at processing.

fields.name: net_amount
docs: Net USDC set aside for the epoch's requests (after the exit fee).

fields.name: amount_left
docs: Net USDC still unclaimed; dust is folded into LP capital when the last request claims.

fields.name: shares_return_left
docs: Unfilled shares still in escrow for this epoch's requests; dust is burned when the last request claims.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Requests of this epoch not yet claimed.

types.name: FeeKind
docs: Fee kinds, for events and the conservation invariant.

types.name: ForwardStarted
docs: A forward-starting swap's start snapshot was taken: `accrual_start` is the benchmark's
cumulative accrual at `start_ts`, `fixing_kind` says how it was read (`swap::FixingKind` as `u8`).

types.name: HookFlags
docs: Hook points. Hooks observe and veto entries only (open, deposit); no exit (withdraw, cancel, settle,
liquidate) makes a hook CPI in any mode, so no hook can ever veto or starve an exit (review F-30, ADR-003).
The four retired exit points keep their slots so the layout and the point discriminators are stable; they must
be false and never fire. Hook CPIs are made in `Normal` mode only.

fields.name: before_open
docs: Veto point: a non-zero return refuses the open.

fields.name: after_open
docs: Notification after the open is booked; the pool account bytes carry the post-open state.

fields.name: reserved_2
docs: Retired (was `before_cancel`). Must be false.

fields.name: reserved_3
docs: Retired (was `after_cancel`). Must be false.

fields.name: before_deposit
docs: Veto point: a non-zero return refuses the deposit.

fields.name: after_deposit
docs: Notification after the deposit is booked; the pool account bytes carry the post-deposit state.

fields.name: reserved_6
docs: Retired (was `before_withdraw`). Must be false.

fields.name: reserved_7
docs: Retired (was `after_settle`). Must be false.

fields.name: limit_pay_bp
docs: Highest fixed rate accepted on the pay-fixed leg (pool A), bp.

fields.name: limit_receive_bp
docs: Lowest fixed rate accepted on the receive-fixed leg (pool B), bp.

fields.name: client_seed
docs: Seed of both legs' swap PDAs (one per pool, so the keys differ).

fields.name: start
docs: Index into `vernier::START_DAYS` (0: 28 days, 1: 60 days, 2: 90 days).

types.name: OperatingMode
docs: Kill switch and graceful degradation, designed in from day one.

fields.name: book_pay
docs: Open book aggregates (ADR-008, ADR-017 section 2), kept per leg since external scan 1 (M-4): the pay-fixed
side and the receive-fixed side are clamped to their own collateral separately, so an unbounded gain on
one side can never be netted against an uncollectible loss on the other. Each side is signed with +1 for
pay-fixed and -1 for receive-fixed swaps and maintained exactly by `open` (add) and `close` (subtract), so
the unrealised value of the book is an O(1) function of the benchmark accrual, the published value and
the clock; see `Pool::book_value`. Units: notional in USDC base units, times basis-point-seconds or seconds.

fields.name: collateral_pay
docs: Trader collateral held per side; `collateral_held` is their sum.

fields.name: limited_window_start
docs: Limited-mode budget window (simulation S-2): new notional opened in this pool since `limited_window_start`
may not exceed `Global::limited_mode_cap` within `LIMITED_WINDOW_SECS`, in addition to the per-swap cap.

fields.name: fees_buyback_accrued
docs: Unswept platform fees held in this pool's vault, buyback half (review F-29, ADR-001, ADR-013). Fees
accrue per pool so the hot path never writes the singleton `Global` or a shared fee account.

fields.name: fees_treasury_accrued
docs: Unswept platform fees held in this pool's vault, treasury half.

fields.name: withdraw_reserved
docs: USDC set aside in the vault for processed, unclaimed queued withdrawals (ADR-009). Not LP capital.

fields.name: ladder
docs: Maturity ladder (external scan 1, M-5): open swaps counted by maturity day. Maturities fall on UTC
midnights, so a day bucket is exact: once a bucket's midnight has passed and its count is not zero, a
matured swap is awaiting settlement and LP pricing is suspended until it is settled (anyone may settle it
and is paid a bounty for doing so). Bucket `day % MATURITY_BUCKETS` holds six little-endian bytes: the
`u32` day it counts and a `u16` count, so a stale bucket is detected rather than aliased. Raw bytes rather
than typed arrays so that loading the account is a copy, not a per-element decode (stack frame bound).

fields.name: share_supply
docs: Mirror of the share mint supply, so that paths without the mint account (`trader_open_swap`) can value
queued shares (M-18). Asserted equal to the mint wherever the mint is present.

fields.name: queued_shares
docs: Mirror of the withdrawal queue's open epoch (M-18): shares queued and the slot of the epoch's first
request, zero when none. A new swap may not consume the capacity an eligible epoch is waiting for.

types.name: Pricer
docs: Which pricing curve quotes this pool. `External` is reserved for v1.1 (pricer CPI); creating such a pool
is permitted so governance can stage it, but quotes fail with `PricerMismatch` until the CPI path ships.

fields.name: limited_window_start
docs: Limited-mode window this swap's notional was charged to, 0 when opened outside Limited mode (M-17).

fields.name: link
docs: Basis swap link: the key of the other leg's `Swap` account, zero for an ordinary swap.
Carved out of the former 56-byte reserve together with `link_flags`, so the account size is unchanged
and every swap written before the link existed reads as unlinked.

fields.name: link_flags
docs: `LINK_BASIS` when this swap is one leg of a basis swap; `LINK_LEG_B` additionally on the receive-fixed
leg. Zero on an ordinary swap.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Forward-starting swap: the UTC midnight the floating accrual begins. Zero on a spot
swap, and ignored unless `LINK_FORWARD` is set, so an account written before this field reads unchanged.

fields.name: fixing_kind
docs: `swap::FixingKind` as `u8`: how the accrual at maturity was read (0 live, 1 segment, 2 fixing,
3 interpolated, 4 fallback). Always 0 for cancel before maturity and for liquidation.

types.name: SwapOpened
docs: Events, emitted through `emit_cpi!` with the pool sequence so indexers detect gaps.

types.name: VernierParamsOnChain
docs: Vernier parameters as stored on chain (mirror of `vernier::Params`).

fields.name: escrow
docs: Pool-owned token account holding escrowed shares.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Open epoch: new requests join it.

fields.name: first_request_slot
docs: Slot of the first request in the open epoch; 0 when it has none.

fields.name: queued_shares
docs: Shares escrowed for the open epoch.

fields.name: request_count
docs: Requests in the open epoch.

fields.name: lp_usdc
docs: Destinations recorded at enqueue for clients; a claim accepts these or any other token accounts the LP
owns (H-1).
